# Super Telecom

> Professional mobile repair and second-hand smartphone store in Giridih, Jharkhand — 10+ years of trusted service for screen replacement, battery replacement, motherboard repair, refurbished phones and premium mobile accessories.

Super Telecom is a Giridih-based repair shop and retailer. Same-day repairs for all major brands (iPhone, Samsung, Xiaomi, Realme, OPPO, Vivo, OnePlus, Motorola, Nokia), warranty-backed refurbished smartphones, and a wide range of accessories including chargers, cables, covers, tempered glass and power banks.
